title: racinaea parviflora var. expansa
intro: Racinaea parviflora var. expansa, commonly known as the miniature epiphytic bromeliad, is a type of plant species in the bromeliad family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Racinaea parviflora var. expansa include its ability to act as an anxiolytic and sedative, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
